label: Astro (static) with React islands
stack: Astro (static output) with React islands where a page needs JavaScript, Tailwind CSS v4.

boundaries: Never add `unsafe-inline` to the CSP or an inline `<script>` with content that Astro doesn't process. Scripts that must run before paint are files in `public/`.
Layout additions go in `src/parts/<slot>/` (head, body-start, header-end, footer, body-end), not into `Base.astro`. Modules rely on that.
pitfalls: Built pages are files (`/about.html`), so `Astro.url.pathname` can end in `.html`. Pass it through `routePath()` from `src/lib/routes.ts` before comparing or building URLs.
The CSP drops inline `style=` attributes without an error. Use classes; for a value that varies, use a lookup map of classes.
A third-party origin (embed, API, script) needs a file in `config/csp/`. Without one the browser blocks it.
